title: StackKit Advanced change-set result v1
description: Terramate orchestration report of one `stackkit advanced change-set apply` on the local host, carried as data.changeSetResult of the stackkit.advanced-mutation/v1 command result. internal/terramatehost owns the semantics: after the target apply, the host project is materialized, `terramate list --run-order --tags stackkit` must equal the graph run order, and every affected local stack runs `terramate run --no-recursive --tags stackkit -- tofu plan -detailed-exitcode -input=false`.

hostManifestSha256.description: Digest of the stackkit.terramate-host-manifest/v1 document at .stackkit/terramate-host-manifest.json; equals the terramateHostManifestSha256 of the applied change set.

materialized.description: Workspace-relative files this run wrote. Empty when the host project was already current.

runOrder.description: Stack IDs in the order `terramate list --run-order` printed them for this host.

affectedStacks.description: The change set's affected stack IDs in stack graph run order, across every host.

status.description: converged when every affected local stack converged or is an allowed pending_root; otherwise not_converged and the change set failed and rolled back.

stacks.description: One entry per affected stack, in affectedStacks order. Empty when the orchestration stopped before the convergence plans.

status.description: converged: plan exit 0. drifted: plan exit 2 after apply (fails the change set). failed: the plan could not run. pending_root: the runtime root has no main.tf yet; fails the change set for core and workload roles only. other_host: the stack belongs to another host project and runs through that host's execution channel.

planExitCode.description: Exit code of `tofu plan -detailed-exitcode` as relayed by `terramate run`. Absent when no plan ran.
